en: Colorized vintage view over a town in a mountain valley, surrounded by high rocky peaks partly capped with snow. In the foreground there is a curving stone path and wall, with trees and vegetation below. The middle ground shows a dense cluster of buildings with red roofs, a church with a tall pointed steeple on the left, and a large fortified-looking complex with towers on the right. The word "Trento" is printed in red at the top left of the image against the sky.
